# [Feat] epd: Support and optimize EPD performance for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash

[Upstream PR](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43856) · state: open · merged: False

## Original PR description

<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash was not yet supported under the EPD (Encode-Prefill-Decode) disaggregation pipeline. This PR extends the existing  support to cover DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, enabling disaggregated serving where the vision encoder runs on a separate encode server and the language model runs on a prefill server.Then we went a step further and made optimizations on e-p pipeline and encode server effiency.
Dsv4.1 vit rope kernel opt was separated as #44451.

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

## Modifications

- support EPD pipeline on DeepSeek V4.1.
  - Allow DeepseekV4ForCausalLM in the EPD encoder model list and add --encoder-only ViT/aligner loading.
  - Add preprocess_mm_for_encoder / encoder token counting for the DSV4.1 sentinel image span.
  - Add prefill get_mm_data to splice encoder embeddings by img_grid_thw; skip decode image reprocess on MM pad sentinels.
- ~~support Mooncake tp_broadcast opt.~~
  - ~~Let only TP0 pull Mooncake RDMA embeddings; other ranks wait for broadcast.~~
  - ~~Broadcast embedding buffer + MM metadata via tp_group.broadcast_tensor_dict.~~
  - ~~Cut encoder→Prefill RDMA fanout from TP-wide to a single receiver rank.~~
- separate image loader.
  - Extract multiprocess image decoding into a dedicated image_loader module.
  - Feed preloaded images into preprocess so decode and HF/model preprocess stay aligned.
  - Overlap media I/O with the encoder event loop without changing preprocess semantics.
- overlap the process_mm_item with vit encode.
  - Add a two-stage CPU preprocess → GPU forward pipeline when image loader is enabled.
  - Split dispatch into prep / forward workers so the next batch preprocesses while the current batch encodes.
  - Run ViT forward on a dedicated thread to keep the asyncio loop free during GPU work.
- support optimized vit rope  kernel .[#44451 ]
  - Add a fused CUDA kernel for vision apply_rotary / apply_vision_rotary.
  - Keep the same API as the eager path and gate it with SGLANG_DSV41_VIT_ROPE_CUDA.
- ~~add dsv4.1 vit cuda graph and unify cuda graph envs.~~
  - ~~Add Dsv41ViTCudaGraphRunner with shape-keyed capture / replay for ViT forward.~~
  - ~~Unify Kimi-K3 and DSV4.1 under shared SGLANG_VIT_CUDA_GRAPH_* envs (with aliases).~~

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

## Accuracy Tests
In the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash tech report, the VLM benchmark dataset appears to have only been used to test the  base model. So we tested dsv4.1 on MMMU_PRO dataset (1730 samples) on colocate  and epd deployment for accuracy correctness, and get the corresponding score.

## Speed Tests and Profiling
### Deploy and cmd
We mainly tested the perfermance on B200.The  cmd will be listed as following:

- pd deployment
  - prefill
    ```shell
    python -m sglang.launch_server \
        --host 0.0.0.0 \
        --decode-log-interval 100 \
        --max-running-requests 256  \
        --watchdog-timeout 1000000  \
        --tp-size 8 \
        --chunked-prefill-size 8192 \
        --max-prefill-tokens 16384 \
        --model-path /local2/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
        --trust-remote-code \
        --disable-cuda-graph \
        --mem-fraction-static 0.8  \
        --moe-runner-backend auto  \
        --port 100 \
        --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3  \
        --enable-cache-report \
        --allow-auto-truncate \
        --disaggregation-mode=prefill \
        --mm-feature-transport cuda_ipc   \
        --image-processor-backend pil
     ```
  - decode
     ```shell
      export SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK=512
      TVM_FFI_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=10.0  python -m sglang.launch_server \
        --model-path /local2/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
        --trust-remote-code \
        --tp-size 8 \
        --ep-size 8 \
        --dp-size 8 \
        --enable-dp-attention \
        --enable-dp-lm-head \
        --device cuda \
        --host 0.0.0.0 \
        --port 100  \
        --mem-fraction-static 0.65 \
        --attention-backend trtllm_mla \
        --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4    \
        --chunked-prefill-size=8192 \
        --max-running-requests=2048  \
        --cuda-graph-bs-decode 1 4 8 16 24 32 48 64 80 96 112 128 160 192 256 \
        --watchdog-timeout 1200 \
        --disable-chunked-prefix-cache \
        --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \
        --enable-cache-report \
        --allow-auto-truncate \
        --skip-server-warmup \
        --enforce-shared-experts-fusion \
        --disaggregation-mode=decode \
        --disaggregation-ib-device '{"0":"mlx5_bond_0","1":"mlx5_bond_1","2":"mlx5_bond_2","3":"mlx5_bond_3","4":"mlx5_bond_4","5":"mlx5_bond_5","6":"mlx5_bond_6","7":"mlx5_bond_7"}' \
        --image-processor-backend pil
    ```


- epd deployment
  - encoder
     ```shell
    #export SGLANG_EPD_MOONCAKE_ENCODER_SEND_POOL=1
    export SGLANG_ENCODER_EAGER_IMAGE_DECODE=1
    export SGLANG_ENCODER_ENABLE_IMAGE_LOADER=1
    export SGLANG_ENCODER_OVERLAP_PREPROCESS=1
    export SGLANG_DSV41_VIT_ROPE_CUDA=1
    #export SGLANG_VIT_ENABLE_CUDA_GRAPH=1 
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4 TVM_FFI_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=10.0 python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
        --host 0.0.0.0 \
        --port 100 \
        --model-path /local2/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
        --trust-remote-code \
        --encoder-only \
        --enable-prefix-mm-cache \
        --encoder-transfer-backend mooncake \
        --disaggregation-ib-device mlx5_bond_4 
    ```
  - prefill
    ```shell

    export SGLANG_EPD_PRECOMPUTED_EMBEDDING_FAST_PATH=1
    export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=pinned_reserve_segment_size_mb:16384,pinned_use_cuda_host_register:True,pinned_num_register_threads:8
    TVM_FFI_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=10.0  python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
       --host 0.0.0.0 \
       --decode-log-interval 100 \
       --max-running-requests 256 \
       --watchdog-timeout 1000000 \
       --tp-size 8 \

       --disable-cuda-graph \
       --port 100 \
       --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \
       --enable-cache-report \
       --allow-auto-truncate \
       --disable-flashinfer-autotune \
       --language-only \
       --encoder-urls http://172.16.0.5:100 \
       --encoder-transfer-backend mooncake \
       --disaggregation-ib-device '{"0":"mlx5_bond_0","1":"mlx5_bond_1","2":"mlx5_bond_2","3":"mlx5_bond_3","4":"mlx5_bond_4","5":"mlx5_bond_5","6":"mlx5_bond_6","7":"mlx5_bond_7"}' \

      --enable-cache-report \

      --image-processor-backend pil
     ```

#### Common workload

- 16K text tokens and 16 text images with 832x832 pixels
- concurrency is set to 16
- with 63% text cache hit

### Performance Result
We conducted a series of experiments and ultimately achieved a 63% reduction on TTFT and a 47% gain on throughput  per gpu on this workload.

- liusy58 · comment · 2026-10-13T07:16:50Z · [source](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43856#issuecomment-6140387636)

@ZhengWG Could you please take a look at this PR? 

- ZhengWG · comment · 2026-10-15T03:20:16Z · [source](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43856#issuecomment-6183631524)

Thanks for the work! Overall, I'd suggest keeping this PR focused on the main win, i.e. DSV4.1 EPD support plus the overlap pipeline. The ViT RoPE kernel would be better as its own PR, since it isn't EPD-only. As for CUDA graph, TP broadcast and the send pool, I'd drop them from this PR for now and send each one separately once its benefit is validated.

For context, I ran a stepwise ablation of each feature on 8×H20-3e (DSV4.1 Flash, TP8 language-only prefill + encoder over Mooncake, single node):

- **Overlap (image loader + two-stage preprocess/forward pipeline):** a clear win when the encoder is the bottleneck, with ~33–38% lower mean TTFT and +13–23% throughput on an image-heavy workload. When prefill is the bottleneck, the encoder still gets faster (/encode −29%), but end-to-end TTFT barely moves.
- **ViT RoPE kernel:** a small but consistent gain, ~2–6% TTFT (the kernel itself is ~5.5× faster than eager). It also changes the colocate DSV4.1 path, not just EPD.
- **ViT CUDA graph, Mooncake TP broadcast, encoder send pool:** no noticeable gain in my local tests, all within ±1% TTFT.
